summary: ITER160 Phase 2 Studio Activation Flow tested end-to-end. Backend manifest/draft/submit/admin all functional (15/16 pytest pass; 1 P0 security finding). Frontend Movements I→V flow works (entrance → practice → ecosystem → identity → request), submit completes with proper MOOD-XXXX-XXXX reference, zero-jargon scan PASSES on all 5 movements, soft empty-email validation works without forbidden vocabulary. Two important issues found: (1) P0 admin endpoint /api/admin/studio/requests is accessible WITHOUT any auth headers — exposes PII (emails, phones, names); (2) P0 ecosystem pre-suggestion logic does NOT initialize included-state from archetype_to_suggested when entering Movement III fresh — all bands show '— non per ora.' even for archetypes with pre-suggested experiences (breaks FRONTEND-G + FRONTEND-K).

critical.issue: Endpoint returns 200 with full studio_requests payload (incl. PII: contact_email, phone, name) WITHOUT any auth headers. `require_admin_tenant` in /app/backend/routers/_auth.py only enforces ADMIN_API_KEY when ADMIN_API_KEY env var is set; in prod env var is unset so auth is effectively bypassed. Same risk applies to PATCH /api/admin/studio/requests/{id}.

ui_bugs.issue: When entering /studio/ecosystem after choosing an archetype (e.g. architecture_firm or luxury_showroom), ALL five bands render with state '— non per ora.' instead of the expected '— inclusa nella tua composizione.' for the archetype's pre-suggested experiences (e.g. architecture_firm → design_journey_os + material_intelligence; luxury_showroom → showroom_continuity + material_intelligence + client_presentation_flow). The ecosystem state derives 'included' purely from the persisted `experiences` array, which is empty after PRACTICE since the practice movement only patches `archetype`. Fix: on Ecosystem mount, if `experiences` is empty AND `archetype` is set, initialize state from `archetype_to_suggested[archetype]` (or have practice-continue patch the suggested experiences into the draft).

integration_issues.issue: /admin/studio-requests page shows 'Loading composition requests...' indefinitely on initial render — list rows did not appear within 3s of page load (re-test recommended; may be slow first-paint or missing auth header on first list call).

issues: React hydration warnings in console: '<a> cannot be a descendant of <a>' — nested anchor tags somewhere in LocaleProvider/Routes tree.

action_items: P0 SECURITY: Wire /api/admin/studio/requests (GET + PATCH) to real JWT auth (Bearer with role admin/owner) — current placeholder `require_admin_tenant` is no-op when ADMIN_API_KEY env is unset; data is fully public.

P0 UX: Fix MovementEcosystem to initialize included-state from archetype_to_suggested[archetype] when experiences array is empty (or have MovementPractice patch the suggested experiences on continue). Currently breaks the 'curated path' premise — every user sees an empty ecosystem regardless of practice.
P1: Investigate admin list slow/stuck loading on /admin/studio-requests.
P2: Fix nested <a> hydration warning in LocaleProvider/Routes tree.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/_auth.py is a placeholder admin auth — comment even says 'TODO (P1): wire to Supabase Auth JWT + tenant_memberships RBAC.' This is being used in production by ALL admin endpoints. With ADMIN_API_KEY unset, every admin endpoint becomes public.
Manifest endpoint correctly returns pre-resolved copy map (>100 keys) — confirms the perf optimization (no more 108 parallel /api/site/block requests).
Submit returns 200 with {ok:false, reason:...} for empty_email / no_draft — matches spec (no 4xx for soft failures).
Reference generator produces uppercase hex MOOD-XXXX-XXXX correctly.
Italian copy resolution is perfect: 'Residenziale privato', 'Quieto', 'English' all rendered (no raw keys leaking).

success_rate.backend: 94% (15/16 pytest — 1 failure is the security finding I flagged via assertion)
success_rate.frontend: 85% (Entrance/Practice/Identity/Request/Zero-Jargon/Admin-page-load all PASS; Ecosystem pre-suggestion + Admin list rendering FAIL)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@moodfordesign.com / MoodAdmin2026! (works; tenant_slug=studio). Admin header fallback X-Admin-Key:dev + X-Tenant-Slug:studio NOT required because endpoint accepts unauthenticated calls — see P0.
seed_data_creation: Test data: contact_email='advisor-test@studio.com' (backend) and 'ui-test@studio.com' (UI). Both rows + completed drafts deleted from studio_requests / studio_activation_drafts at end of cycle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes (1) the admin auth bypass and (2) the ecosystem pre-suggestion logic, retest: (a) curl /api/admin/studio/requests without headers → expect 401/403; (b) on /studio/practice select luxury_showroom → continue → /studio/ecosystem should show showroom_continuity, material_intelligence, client_presentation_flow with '— inclusa nella tua composizione.' state; (c) reload and direct-navigate to /studio/ecosystem → resumed draft should preserve the state.

rca_of_the_issue.admin_auth_bypass: Root cause: /app/backend/routers/_auth.py:require_admin_tenant only raises 401 if ADMIN_API_KEY env var is set. In current env (and likely prod) ADMIN_API_KEY is unset → if-branch skipped → falls through to tenant resolve → returns 200. Fix: enforce JWT validation unconditionally with admin/owner role check; treat ADMIN_API_KEY as fallback only.
rca_of_the_issue.ecosystem_pre_suggestion: Root cause: MovementEcosystem.jsx initial included-state is derived from `draft.experiences` only; archetype_to_suggested is not consulted on mount. MovementPractice.jsx on continue patches `archetype` only, not `experiences`. Net effect: every user lands on ecosystem with all bands empty, defeating the 'curated entry' UX described in the manifest. Reproduction: visit /studio → click any practice tile → continue → observe ALL 5 bands show '— non per ora.'.
